narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (US-Iran, Israel-Hezbollah, Ukraine-Russia) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with the Strait of Hormuz blockade persisting and asymmetric threats rising. The market is underpricing the duration and severity of these disruptions, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and gold; short S&P 500 and emerging market equities; overweight USD and short-dated Treasuries.

narratives.title: Energy Supply Chain Disruption
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy assets as the Hormuz blockade structurally tightens oil supply, with EIA forecasts rising and Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines. The SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals government concern, while diplomatic progress remains uncertain, supporting elevated oil prices.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI and Brent futures; long energy sector equities (XLE); short refined product spreads on refinery disruption risk.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Mirage vs. Reality
narratives.summary: Capital is skeptical of White House claims of Iran deal progress, as military readiness and actual strikes contradict diplomatic narratives. This uncertainty keeps risk premia elevated, with markets pricing a fragile status quo that could break either way, favoring hedging over directional bets.
narratives.trade_implication: Long VIX futures and put spreads on SPX; short USD/CHF on safe-haven flows; long gold as a hedge against diplomatic failure.
